entry_points.text: Submount detection walks descendants under mount read protection and reports live mounts without sync unmount.
Reclaim offers per-superblock shrink walks with disposal, batched draining in 1024s until LRU empties, and alias pruning to a private list.
Cursors allocate anonymous entries with cursor markers and referenced parents; external teardown frees name then object; unmount warns on busy; submount search returns first with ref.

Early setup prepares lookup buckets and hash tables unless deferred; late setup creates dentries, inodes, names, files and mounts caches with counter, derives max files from memory with bound and inline area.
Mount init creates mount caches and tables, prepares device numbers and kernfs, brings up system memory filesystems, builds initial tree and retains failfs root or aborts boot.

exports.text: Zero a byte range of a DAX inode, reporting whether work was done; tail zeroing completes at once when the position is block aligned.
DAX IO maps control and iterator to iteration, rejects atomic, advances position with write asserting exclusive guard; faults dispatch by order; sync completion persists then installs mapping.
DAX remap delegates to shared validation checking mutability, limits, draining IO, normalizing zero length, verifying dedupe equality and marking modified; DAX compare walks two ranges for equality.
Post modify clears stripped privileges and refreshes times under mount write access; waiters block for DIO quiescence or test completion; write-opened files use a fast RO check.
Alias acquisition passes errors through, rejects missing inodes as stale, reuses existing aliases and consumes the reference on success; case-insensitive add probes hash then splices.

Splice and attach bind inodes with default or caller ops; fresh bind needs negative entry, notifies security and releases creation state; directory aliases reuse only for directories with ancestor loop error.
Tree mutation moves, exchanges and rehashes entries under rename exclusion; lookup starts from generic hash with filesystem handler; parallel removal wakes waiters; parent number uses RCU then guard.
Transient files label unlinked negatives with numeric or caller names under length limits; default op install derives presence bits from non-null handlers and refreshes superblock.

hazards.text: Copy-on-write faults track private pages; unexpected kinds warn once and surface as IO or bus errors with short mappings treated as possible corruption.
External helpers for warnings, locks, lists, atomics, RCU, DAX, folio, cache and errors are owned elsewhere and not specified here.

invariants.text: Holes read as zeros without storage; shared extents need copy-around with invalidation before modify; zero and IO advance in page steps; signals interrupt, poison tries recovery, no progress fails.
Order zero is page and huge order is huge page with single page or huge length; reads stop at size with beyond as bus errors; compare steps on overlap with paired holes equal and hole-data unequal.
No-change-time is a dedicated flag bit; update skips when flagged, when mode requests it, or when times current with no version need, else runs under mount access.

Remap needs aligned starts, no wrap, source inside size, dest limits, block granularity with end rounding, no same-file overlap and shorten only when allowed, else bad for dedupe and invalid for copy; writes cap by rlimit and max.
Dedupe compare walks page steps with one folio per side, locks pair, revalidates after lock, maps both for byte compare, releases each step, stops on difference and reports via flag.

Pressure numerator and denominator default 100 with lower bounds; state read-only, negative bounded bool; controls publish dentry-state, dentry-negative and pressure pair with 0444 and 0644 and register early; totals sum per-cpu clamped, cache pointer and hash frozen after init.

Same-parent unalias needs no extra sync, cross-parent needs rename mutex plus shared parent or stale with veto hooks; fscrypt move clears markers in one build only; link drop dirties; hash size is boot option with empty bdev init; parent read tries RCU then guard.

locks.text: DAX mapping, zeroing and comparison hold a read lock across the section, releasing on all exits with the identifier.
Remap preparation waits for DIO on both inodes and writes back both ranges before content checks or length validation.
Folio pairs lock in increasing index order with single lock when same, unlocking symmetrically to avoid deadlock.
Name snapshots copy inline names and count external names under RCU with sequence retry, retrying freeing targets; release drops last with deferred free.
Dontcache and alias search hold the inode lock; aliases take entry locks briefly, preferring hashed or grabbable entries with NORCU and freeing checks.
LRU isolation flips list membership under locks, adjusts unused tallies and uses trylock for inverted order, skipping contended, detaching active and rotating referenced once.

Relocation holds rename exclusion with ordered parent guards, inode-outside-entry nesting and roots guard for root links; lookup removal holds entry then bucket with wake; sequences use even stable odd busy with preemption disabled.

state_machines.text: Page faults validate size, acquire cache entry, avoid huge collisions, process extents with major accounting, release with tracing and map errors to fault codes with retry on races.
Huge faults validate, check fallback, acquire ordered entry, avoid overlap, process full extents, split and account on fallback; alternate build always falls back.
Synchronous faults return need-sync with frame; completion persists the range then installs mapping, reporting bus error when persistence fails.
Shrink walks skip start, move dead or unreferenced entries to dispose with counting, exit early when progressing; variants clear persistence or capture unmovable victims.

structs.text: Dentry accounting uses six slots for total, unused, age, wanted, negative and reserve with per-cpu totals; empty, slash and dotdot have lengths 0,1,2; lookup width 10 with 1024 buckets; initial age 45.
Dentries link via alias chain, parent and root membership with ops, sequence and lookup node; names are inline or refcounted external with combined hash length, swapped or copied with refs.
Completion nodes chain with embedded completions; mount probes pair a mount with found flag; shrink state skips start with shared result and dispose list; walks use four controls.
